map.输入喷头流量、喷头数量、喷幅与作业速度，计算每亩药液用量与作业效率，辅助植保无人: Input nozzle flow, nozzle count, spray width and operating speed to compute per-mu liquid amount and work efficiency, aiding UAV/sprayer application planning.
map.Q = q × N；药液量/亩 = 40 × Q ÷ (W × v)；效率 =: Q = q × N; liquid/mu = 40 × Q ÷ (W × v); efficiency = W × v × 1.5
map.总流量 Q 为单喷头流量 q 与喷头数 N 之积；按喷幅 W 与作业速度 v 折: Total flow Q is single-nozzle flow q times nozzle count N; by spray width W and speed v derive per-mu liquid amount and efficiency (1 mu ≈ 666.7 m²).
map.💡 公式：总流量 Q = 单喷头流量 × 喷头数；亩用药液量 = 40 × Q: 💡 Formula: total flow Q = single flow × nozzle count; liquid/mu = 40 × Q ÷ (spray width × speed) (L/mu); efficiency = spray width × speed × 1.5 (mu/h). 1 mu ≈ 666.67 m².
map.喷幅与作业速度不能为0，否则无法计算: Spray width and speed cannot be 0, otherwise cannot compute
map.亩用药液量过小可能导致漏喷，过大易产生药害: Too little liquid/mu may cause missed spray; too much risks phytotoxicity
map.实际作业受风力、地形、药液粘度影响，结果仅供参考: Actual work is affected by wind, terrain and liquid viscosity; results are for reference

map.飞防作业规划：按喷头流量、喷幅、飞行速度算单位面积药液用量与作业效率: Flight-control planning: from nozzle flow, spray width, flight speed compute per-area liquid amount and efficiency
map.药液配制：由亩用量与作业面积反推需带药液总量: Liquid preparation: from per-mu usage and area back-solve total liquid to carry
map.参数校核：速度过快会导致亩用量不足、防效下降: Parameter check: too-fast speed reduces per-mu usage and efficacy
map.总流量 Q=单喷头流量×喷头数（L/min）；亩用量=40×Q÷(喷幅 m×速度: Total flow Q=single flow×nozzle count (L/min); liquid/mu=40×Q÷(width m×speed km/h) (L/mu); efficiency=width×speed×1.5 (mu/h). Width and speed jointly set per-area deposit.
Single 1.2 L/min, 4 nozzles, width 6 m, speed 6 km/h: Q=1.2×4=4.8 L/min, liquid/mu=40×4.8÷(6×6)=5.33 L/mu, efficiency=6×6×1.5=54 mu/h; raise speed to 8 km/h and liquid/mu drops to 4.0 L/mu, efficacy may fall short.
map.大田飞防常规亩用液量约 0.8~2 L，5.33 L/亩偏高、多为弥雾/果树场景: Field UAV conventional liquid is about 0.8~2 L/mu; 5.33 L/mu is high, mostly misting/orchard scenarios; this example is conservative — set target liquid by crop, chemical and nozzle, then back-tune speed.
map.速度为什么不能太快？: Why can't speed be too fast?
map.速度↑→单位面积着药↓，过快会漏喷、防效下降；同时风场扰动使雾滴飘移，须平衡效率: Faster → less deposit per area → missed spray and lower efficacy; also wind-field disturbance drifts droplets — balance efficiency and deposition uniformity.
